name: Donor engagement

subjectOf.text: By giving the power of the endowment to the DAO the donor relinquishes control over the assets in exchange for community governance, and that relinquishment builds trust and community buy in, which in turn secures growth and legacy for the donor's purpose.
subjectOf.abstract: The donor can help mold the community to some extnt but at the same time the donor releases the control to the community. The relinquishment of control builds trust and community buy in. This in turn, ensures growth and legacy for the respective purpose of the donor and the associated DAO.
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
scope_conditions: donors willing to cede asset control to a community of experts

subjectOf.text: Any exercise of the multisig endowment wallet keys ultimately depends on a vote in the assembly of the DAO association that serves as legal wrapper, so a donor holding one key among many is involved in endowment payment decisions without controlling them.
subjectOf.abstract: The exercise of the multisig wallet keys will ultimately always depend on a CHARITYxDAO vote in the assembly of the CHARITYxDAO association (the legal wrapper – if chosen to be a Swiss Association). As a multisig key holder, the donor will be involved in multisig endowment payment
subjectOf.citation: Wulf A. Kaal, How Decentralized Autonomous Organizations Optimize Charitable Giving (2021). SSRN: https://ssrn.com/abstract=3981021
scope_conditions: endowment wallets held in a DAO legal wrapper such as a Swiss Association
